name: manual_f23387
claim: The git merge/push/PR discipline (never trust marker-grep alone, check pending-operation state before push, verify diff before writing a PR body) is now mechanically enforced in PT: .githooks/pre-push runs scripts/git/check_no_pending_merge.sh, which blocks on MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD, MERGE_MSG, SQUASH_MSG, and in-progress rebase (rebase-merge/rebase-apply). The script is in the sync-attribution-guard-scripts.sh copy list when syncing from orama-system canonical; each repo still wires its own .githooks/pre-push hook locally. Context-check and verify-diff-before-PR are not git-hookable and stay standing personal discipline.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-30 follow-up to the periscope PR#39 incident (empty-merge PR opened without ever running git commit). User asked to enshrine the fix as an actual pre-push guard, not just a lesson to remember by hand -- implemented in orama-system (canonical), documented in docs/wiki/08-git-hygiene-and-branching.md § 'Merge -> Push -> PR discipline', and synced out. Closes the loop opened by the two earlier lessons on diff-filter=U and MERGE_HEAD checking.
